Privacy notice

Your information

Heat Fitness is run by Heat Fitness Stirling Ltd, which is registered with the Information Commissioner's Office full ICO registration number. This notice explains what we collect and why.

What we collect

Your name and contact details when you get in touch, book or join. Health information you give us on the health form, so we can keep you safe in class. Payment details are handled by our booking system, booking system name, and we never see your full card number.

How we use it

To reply to you, manage your bookings and membership, and keep you safe. We'll only send you news and offers if you've said yes, and you can stop them at any time.

Who we share it with

Only the services we use to run the studio: our booking system, our website host and our email provider. We never sell your information.

How long we keep it

for example, while you're a member and for two years after

Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete the information we hold about you. Email helen@heatfitness.co.uk. If you're unhappy with how we've handled it, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk.
